notes: TOOLING LIMITATION: during this research the page-fetch tool could not resolve any host (DNS failure for every site, including finolexpipes.com), and the session web-search budget ran out before the end. All facts were taken from search-engine extracts of official finolexpipes.com product pages and Finolex catalogue PDFs (URLs in sourceUrls), not from directly opened pages. Spot-check against the live pages before publishing.

PRICES: no official, current Finolex Industries pipe price list could be found or opened. Search results only gave third-party aggregator pages, dealer listings, a 2021 distributor copy, and Finolex Cables (a separate company) lists. Every listPrice/mrp is therefore null; obtain the current list from the Finolex distributor.
IMAGES: none recorded. Official image URLs could not be read because product pages could not be fetched. All images arrays are empty and need to be filled from finolexpipes.com.

Material codes in specifications are Finolex's own codes as shown on the product pages. They can help when ordering from the distributor. Finolex pages sometimes give conflicting codes for similar items (e.g. Selfit vs Ringfit SWR bends), so confirm with the distributor.
CPVC Pipe SDR 13.5: the product page lists 15–50 mm in SDR 11 and SDR 13.5, but one Finolex brochure lists only SDR 11. Confirm which SDR 13.5 sizes the distributor actually stocks.
CPVC pipes come in 3 m and 5 m lengths, and ASTM pipes in 3 m and 6 m, so altUnit is null for them. Set altUnit once the stocked length is known.
CPVC Reducer: only combinations confirmed in search extracts are included. 40×32, 50×32, 50×40 and others probably exist (the code series continues) but were not confirmed.
CPVC Ball Valve: the size table lists 15–50 mm; the feature text on the same page says 15–80 mm. Only 15–50 mm is included. HSN set to 8481 (valves) per README; confirm with accountant.
CPVC FTA Brass Insert: the only source page found has an "-old" URL suffix. Sizes and codes come from that page.
CPVC Solvent Cement: Finolex lists pack sizes 59/118/237/473/946 labelled "gms" (PVC-U cements are labelled ml); the label is kept as Finolex shows it.

ASTM pipes and fittings: only ½"–2" variants are included for the shop's everyday range. Finolex lists pipes up to 8", elbows, tees and couplers up to 4" (and larger), and threaded elbows and tees only up to 2". Plain vs threaded pipe ends are not split into variants; confirm what is stocked.

Agriculture Selfit pipe: Finolex states 20–400 mm in six classes (2.5–12.5 kg/cm²). The class-wise dimension table could not be read cleanly, so the variant set (63/75/90/110 mm × 4 and 6 kg/cm²) is limited to common IS 4985 combinations. The 6 m standard length (altUnit) was read from the Selfit table for 75 mm; confirm for the other sizes.

Column pipe: the size/type rows come from a table extract without column headers. Lengths (1.5 m or 3 m) differ by size and type. The variants listed are rows seen in the extract. Confirm length and the relevant standard with the distributor before selling.

SWR: only the Selfit (solvent-joint) pipe is included. A Ringfit (integrated rubber-ring) pipe range exists, but its lengths are given in feet with single- and double-socket options that could not be read reliably. Bend 45°, plain tee and single Y are listed on Finolex pages in more than one series; the joint type (Selfit/Ringfit) should be confirmed when stocking. P-trap was left out because the only page found was an old one.
SWR standards: Finolex states pipes conform to IS 13592 and fittings to IS 14735.
GST 18% is believed correct for all items (plastic pipes/fittings 3917, valves 8481, solvent cement 3506) but must be confirmed by the shop's accountant.
